q01.why: 6 commitments each with party, capital and date need exact reading in who/what/when columns; dates are mixed (to 2028, Apr 2026) so a timeline scale fits less well

q02.why: 5 entry requirements with thresholds (50%, PUE 1.25, 200MW) are requirements with detail, so a criterion/threshold table beats pills or icons

q03.why: Supporting text of ~4 points (Johor, built to order, platforms, Batam) is bold lead-in commentary beside the corridor map, not a lead exhibit

q04.why: 10 operator names with no numbers, one of three groups, lean to logo tiles; precedent for named players is logo_row

q05.why: Several so-what points (rents, tenants, replacement cost, retrofit, arbitrage) as bold lead-in bullets; takeaway only holds one sentence

q06.why: One framing why-invest sentence fits the dashed takeaway box exactly; bullets are for several points

q07.why: 4 base-case assumption lines set against a second management case; two-case comparison carries the scenario message (precedent Case 1 projections -> bk57)

q08.why: 3 short text points on approval and timing are commentary beside the offer exhibit, not a visual on their own

q09.why: 5 stages with strategic/financial counts narrowing 71 to 1 is a buyer funnel with stage counts; ig107 cannot show exact numbers

q10.why: 8 per-share value ranges by method against a $68.73 current price line is a football field; commentary is thin so bk15 not needed

q11.why: 6 assumption lines (52 words, mixed metrics) are commentary beside a projection table; not one measure so not chartable

q12.why: 5 process stages with company and buyer counts (133 to 8) is a funnel with stage counts; ig107 has no exact numbers

q13.why: 14 peers in two groups across EV/EBITDA, growth, leverage, yield is a trading comps multiples table with mean/median bands

q14.why: Two DCF grids (WACC x exit multiple, WACC x perpetuity growth) are twin sensitivity tables, per precedent

q15.why: 3 party price indications ($28-31) sit as a column in the party-by-stage process table (precedent); too few values to justify a bar

q16.why: Market volume in EB over 2010-2020 with few labelled points is market size over time; fewer than 6 points rules out line

q17.why: One dated sentence (made public 9 Feb 2015) is a single framing note; one date is too few for a timeline

q18.why: 3 framing statements (33 words) above dilution sensitivities are commentary bullets, not the lead exhibit

q19.why: 4 implied multiple ranges (EBITDA, net income by year) need exact reading as labelled numbers; no peer list for bk19

q20.why: 5 explanatory lines on cost components (40 words) are commentary beside the corporate cost table

q21.why: 12-year EPS series is one of several metrics (capex, EBITDA, EPS) in the message, so a 2x2 chart dashboard panel; fin_chart if shown alone

q22.why: Named credential deals by sub-sector with few numbers are tombstone tiles (precedent software deals -> logo_row)

q23.why: 8 dated deals with one multiple (EV/LTM EBITDA, x) plus median rows is a precedent table with inline bars

q24.why: Share price grids on P/E x equity financing for two years (2019E, 2020E) are two sensitivity tables on driver pairs

q25.why: 3 longer basis-of-preparation points (34 words) as a tab beside the plan basis, per precedent Basis of financial plan -> side_tabs

q26.why: 16 companies ranked by one metric (EV, $MM); bar ranks them best, split by SaaS/app/infra group to stay within 15

q27.why: One metric (revenue) over 5 forecast years with a 21% CAGR is a fin_chart with CAGR callout

q28.why: Share price line with 4 results events carrying figures fits callout boxes (<=5); performance periods could go in bk28 side table

q29.why: 7 properties x lease type and cost responsibility (93 words) needs a text table; bk35 caps at 5 entities

q30.why: Premiums paid in precedent squeeze-outs vs undisturbed price and 52-week high is a premiums-paid page

q31.why: Revenue, EBITDA, UFCF lines over 2023A-2028E with % change rows is a bank-format financial table for one segment

q32.why: 4-stage repeating loop with short labels (acquire, professionalise, bolt-on, re-invest) is a four-arrow operating loop

q33.why: 4 sourcing channels narrowing into one platform deal, short labels, no counts: funnel of inputs to one output

q34.why: 3 tiers by firm size, few at top many at base, short labels: a 3-level pyramid; not market sizing so not TAM/SAM/SOM

q35.why: One % score (92%) vs a 95% target on a 0-100 scale is a single speedometer with a marker (precedent utilisation vs average)

q36.why: Site counts across 6 European countries shade a Europe-by-country map; map_pins caps at 6 and suits sites not country counts

q37.why: 4 areas rated full/partial/none is a RAG or Harvey row status for 1-4 items; harvey needs several criteria

q38.why: 5 risks on likelihood vs impact with up/down/flat movement is the risk map with movement arrows

q39.why: 6 dated milestones (Day 1 to Day 100) on a scale are a timeline; ig111 avoids dates on a scale

q40.why: 6 events tied to months in a recurring year is a twelve-month ring with notes; not multi-year

q41.why: 3 workstreams x 3 short steps each matches the three workstreams x three steps layout exactly
